title: Official Phonopy Al / ABACUS plane-wave example
classification: official calculated example, not experiment or a new calculation
frequencyUnitChoiceBasis: Explicit example-entry choice; matching phonopy.yaml factor 21.490680 and official ABACUS convention convert to THz. The band file itself has no frequency-unit field.
scope: One Al atom; the supplied data include relative complex phases between Cartesian components, so single-atom complex-input animation can be checked. Multi-atom optical branches, unequal-mass relative motion, arbitrary complex input, force constants, convergence, DOS, and spectral intensities are not validated by this example.

complexInput.degenerateSubspaceCaution: A single-vector global phase is distinct from a basis change within a degenerate subspace; complex components alone do not establish chirality or topology.
